plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-16 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). The map is headed 'Civil Engineering Technology map for 2026-2027' and states 'This pathway map is for catalog year 2026-2027'. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every row; Table View shows no prerequisites column, so the 'Prerequisites' flags below are Card View only. This plan transcribes the first-listed 2026-2027 pathway, 'Bakersfield College / Civil Engineering Technology / Associate of Science / 64.5-67 units / 4 terms / to CSU', in full; the page shows only the 4-term Bakersfield College segment. The second 2026-2027 pathway ('to Degree', 60-62.5 units, 4 terms) uses the Bakersfield College general-education pattern and is not collected as a separate plan. In 2025-2026 the CSU pathway was listed in 6 terms. The map prints term totals as 15.5-17.5 / 17 / 17-17.5 / 15. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Major List A' (1.5-2) and 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 3 'Major List C' (4-4.5). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 64.5 units. This map was HELD in Wave118 because the first capture's Term 1 and Term 3 rows did not reconcile; the 2026-11-16 re-extraction captured all 20 course rows (5 + 5 + 5 + 5), including BSAD B1 Financial Accounting (4 units, Term 1) and the Term 3 'Major List C' slot, and every term reconciles exactly at minimums, so the hold is cleared. PHYS B2A and ECON C2001 are printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed'; they are named major courses and are recorded with category 'major'. 'Major List A' prints a closed two-course option set (ARCH B1 Introduction to Architecture and Environmental Design; ENGR B47 Introduction to Engineering and Design), 'Major List B' prints a closed two-course option set (ENGR B25 Engineering Graphics with AutoCAD (for CE/CET/EE); INDR B12 Introduction to Drafting and CAD), and 'Major List C' prints a closed two-course option set (STAT C1000 Introduction to Statistics; STAT C1000E Introduction to Statistics); the map prints no per-option units for these lists, so per the standing slot convention the options are named here and the slots themselves are recorded unselected at the printed slot ranges' minimums. PHYS B2A, MATH C2211, PHYS B2B, ARCH B30 and ENGR B40 carry a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View; no other row shows a 'Prerequisites', 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag, so no other prereqs are recorded. General-education slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded.
